name: youworkforthem
description: Find fonts, graphics, and photos, explore previews, and discover similar fonts through YouWorkForThem.

interface.longDescription: Discover fonts, graphics, and photos from YouWorkForThem. Search by visual style or subject, explore product previews and designer details, and find visually similar fonts. Browse real catalog results through interactive cards for creative inspiration, with optional links to view more on YouWorkForThem.
defaultPrompt: Find serif fonts for my next design.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is for browsing and creative inspiration only. It does not present assets as sales listings, display prices, sell products, or process payments. Optional links let users open and view assets on the YouWorkForThem website. There is no checkout or purchase flow in the plugin.

positive.description: Font classification search. No prior context required.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_products once with query="serif" and type="font". Show returned font previews and names with source product links. Do not invent results.

positive.description: Discover graphic textures. No prior context required.
positive.prompt: Find halftone textures for a poster.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_products once with query="halftone texture" and type="graphic". Present returned graphics as browsing and inspiration results.

positive.description: Photo subject search, distinct from font search. No prior context required.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_products once with query="iceland" and type="photo". Present returned photos with their names, previews and product links.

positive.description: Visual font alternatives. No prior context required.
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_similar once with font="Futura". Present returned font matches, preserving source names and links. If the service instead returns ambiguity suggestions, ask the user to choose a suggestion.

positive.description: Inspect a product selected from a previous search. Setup: a preceding search returned Palmore, SKU T17006.
positive.prompt: Show me details for Palmore from those results.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_product with sku="T17006". Show Palmore by Kaligra.co, its returned description, preview images and available style information. Use the returned product URL. Do not invent product facts.

negative.description: Asset editing is outside these catalog tools. Explain the limitation without invoking an MCP tool or claiming an edit.
negative.prompt: Remove the background from my photo.

negative.description: Local font installation is unsupported. Explain that these tools browse the catalog; do not call catalog tools or claim installation.
negative.prompt: Install a font file on my computer.

negative.description: Order refunds are unsupported. Explain the limitation without invoking an MCP tool or claiming a refund.

publication.release_notes: Set the listing category to Creativity for font, graphic, and photo discovery. Retain the existing MCP connection settings, branding, review cases, and demo recording link.
